commands.operation: owned normal stop/init with operations-enabled eval

limitations: Channel fault occurs after possible POST and before confirmed receipt; valuation legitimately remains calculable
Snapshot reads happen only after the observed business boundary; workers are briefly paused with owned factory to stabilize correlation
No source/test/progress edits; no real sources or messages
corrected_harness_expectation: A prior probe incorrectly expected exactly1receipt globally; this run requires exactly1receipt for the subject offer, counts all legitimate independent receipts, and preserves the whole inventory across the channel fault.

previous_probe.classification: Harness expectation error, not a demonstrated product failure
previous_probe.reason: Prior checks incorrectly required exactly1receipt globally and assumed the subject receipt was channel.messages[0]. Other synthetic offers legitimately produced receipts; all per-subject business/frontier checks already passed. Corrected run verifies1receipt for this offer, actual distinct-listing receipt count and preserved complete inventory.
